props.name: reversed
props.description: Newest first: shows the entries in reverse, numbers kept.

props.name: items
props.description: The entries, in order. Or pass `TimelineItem`s as children.

props.name: datePlacement
props.description: `opposite` puts the date across the line from the rest of the entry.

props.name: markers
props.description: `number` counts from `start`. An entry's own `marker` shows in a ring.

props.name: colors
props.description: Accents cycled through the entries; an entry's own `color` wins.

props.name: extend
props.description: Run the line on past the first and last markers, with a cap at each end.

props.name: spacing
props.description: `time` spaces entries by the time between their `at` dates.

props.name: showGaps
props.description: Label each gap on the line, like "1m 3w", with the full length on hover.

props.name: groupBy
props.description: Add a heading whenever the day, month or year of `at` changes.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows placeholder entries; a number sets how many (3 by default).

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown instead of the line when there are no entries.

props.name: locale
props.description: For dates formatted from `at`.

props.name: itemMinWidth
props.description: Horizontal only: how narrow an entry gets before the line scrolls.

props.name: at
props.description: When it happened. Drives time spacing, gap lines, gap labels and grouping.

props.name: marker
props.description: Shown inside a ring marker, like an icon or a number.

props.name: content
props.description: Anything else, under the description.

props.name: color
props.description: Accent for the marker, badge and date; any CSS color.

props.name: date
props.description: Shown as the date. Formatted from `at` when left out.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Beside the title, like a status badge or an icon with a tooltip.

props.name: badge
props.description: A pill above the rest, tinted with the entry's color.

props.name: current
props.description: The entry in progress. Its marker fills in; the ones after it read as upcoming.

components.name: TimelineHeading
components.description: A label on the line between entries, like a month. `groupBy` adds these for you.

examples.title: horizontal · alternate · date across the line
examples.setup:
const rainbow = [
  "oklch(0.75 0.16 55)",
  "oklch(0.8 0.15 80)",
  "oklch(0.7 0.16 20)",
  "oklch(0.7 0.2 350)",
  "oklch(0.65 0.18 295)",
  "oklch(0.6 0.18 265)",
  "oklch(0.75 0.12 200)",
  "oklch(0.72 0.18 145)",
]

const decades: TimelineEntry[] = [1960, 1970, 1980, 1990, 2000, 2010, 2020].map(
  (year) => ({
    id: String(year),
    date: year,
    title: "Lorem ipsum",
    description: "Amet nam in rutrum integer ullamcorper in dictumst bibendum.",
  })
)
examples.code:
<Timeline
  items={decades}
  orientation="horizontal"
  side="alternate"
  datePlacement="opposite"
  markers="dot"
  connector="pin"
  extend
  colors={rainbow}
  itemMinWidth="9rem"
/>
